tooling.message:
refactor(skills): split lernapps-app into a short SKILL.md and rule files

## Intent

The skill lernapps-app loaded all 35 rules at once. It mixed rules for every app with rules that only make sense with the lernapps plan and tooling, and a tool such as Lovable or bolt.new needs the platform rules alone. Split the skill as the Agent Skills specification intends (progressive disclosure), so an agent reads only what it needs.

## Key changes

- SKILL.md says what an app is and where the workflow is, and links four rule files in references/, each with one line on when to read it.
- The four files: platform rules (every app however it is built, plus the catalog entry), workflow rules, tooling rules and archetype rules.
- The platform rules read on their own, for a tool without the lernapps tooling.
- Every rule keeps its id, heading, text, scope and severity byte for byte; only its file changes. The rule page and its anchors stay as they were.
- The new files are exported. Tests check that a skill links and exports each of its files, and that `lernapps update` copies a skill's subfolders.

## Dependencies and side effects

- lernapps/apps 8ffc0e4 (same intent) links the platform rules from the build page.

docs(build): give free builders the platform rules of lernapps-app

## Intent

"Lieber frei bauen?" told users of Lovable or bolt.new to give their tool the whole skill lernapps-app, which also holds the plan workflow and the tooling rules. A free builder needs only the rules that hold for every app.

## Key changes

- The paragraph, in German and English, links the skill's platform rules (references/platform-rules.md) instead of the whole skill.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Needs lernapps/tooling 29be331 (same intent), which creates the file; the link test fails until it is on main.
